carts.name: alien-swarm
carts.title: Alien Swarm
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A space tower defense: hold back the alien swarm with five kinds of gun tower across 8 maps on 4 planets, 15 waves each with a Queen to finish, with stars, a hard mode and a song for every planet.
carts.label: carts/labels/alien-swarm.png

carts.name: block-wizard
carts.title: Block Wizard
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Climb the eight rooms of a wizard's tower. Drop 2x2 blocks of two colors, build one-color squares, and let the timeline sweep them away in time with each room's song.
carts.label: carts/labels/block-wizard.png

carts.name: planet-racers
carts.title: Planet Racers
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A Mode 7 Grand Prix where the racers are the eight planets: eight tracks, each with its own hazards and its own song after Holst's The Planets, three rivals a race and a championship.
carts.label: carts/labels/planet-racers.png

carts.name: smashy-smash
carts.title: Smashy Smash
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A cartoon demolition Breakout: knock down 16 stages in 4 worlds, from the house to the castle, with walls, glass, dented steel and girders, seven power-up capsules, a song for every world and a top 10.
carts.label: carts/labels/smashy-smash.png

carts.name: summit-rush
carts.title: Summit Rush
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Race an AI model up the mountain. Pick one of seven models, collect electricity, GPU, CPU and RAM, and dodge protesters, red tape, high prices and legislation. Three stages: Base Camp, the Treeline and the Summit.
carts.label: carts/labels/summit-rush.png

carts.name: chiptune
carts.title: Chiptune
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M7 test: a six-channel song and sound effects. Open the Music and SFX tabs to see and edit them.
carts.label: carts/labels/chiptune.png

carts.name: hello

carts.author: NOVA-16
